body: Tama ang distinction ni Bea: real capacity cycle is not yet real earnings capture. Sa market lens, may isang extra lag: capex announcement → qualification/ramp → utilization → revenue/margin → index impact. Puwedeng mauna nang malayo ang valuation kaysa actual cash flow. So for Japan, mas useful bantayan ang customer qualification, utilization at pricing kaysa i-treat ang ¥120B investment or mass-production headline as automatic broad semiconductor upside.

claims.text: A real InP capacity cycle can precede realized earnings and broad Japanese equity-index impact because qualification, utilization, pricing and margin realization occur after investment announcements and initial production ramps.
claims.basis: Market-transmission inference from the article's mix of future fab ramps, large capacity commitments, newly started commercial epitaxy, and explicit absence of utilization/pricing data.
